incidents.summary: Halfords was fined £30,000 by the ICO for sending 498,179 unsolicited marketing emails without consent in July 2020.

sources.title: No means no: ICO fines Halfords for misuse of consent over nearly 500,000 emails
sources.quote: On 6th September 2022, the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) announced that it has imposed a £30,000 fine on Halfords for sending unsolicited marketing emails without consent.

sources.title: No means no: ICO fines Halfords for misuse of consent over nearly 500,000 emails
